decision: Promising proof mechanism for integrated diagnostic; not native admission evidence

model_result.scope: Pure sequential model with forced4-way fingerprints; not integrated native correctness, fault, concurrency, or performance coverage.
model_result.next: Integrated Rust journal must bind database identity and exact tracked head sequence, record only successful known logical deltas, invalidate structural/reclaim/unknown publishers, and fall back on missing/poisoned proof.

publication_boundaries.apply_prepared_commit: Only known successful overlay_delta keys may extend coverage; structural/non-delta root publication invalidates the proof interval.
publication_boundaries.finish_overlay_merge_and_synchronous_mer: May preserve logical coverage only when no tombstone reclamation can alter observable versions and the exact previous sequence is tracked.
publication_boundaries.compact_tombstone_leaves: Invalidate coverage; preserves existing version/conflict semantics.
publication_boundaries.untracked_engine_commit: Exact tracked-through == current head requirement fails; next known publication resets coverage to its new sequence.
publication_boundaries.reopen_or_budget_reset: Empty journal, coverage starts at current head; old snapshots cannot borrow proof.
publication_boundaries.range_witnesses: Keep full existing range validation; this design certifies point/blind keys only.

required_integration_guards: Existing database instance and future-snapshot checks run before any proof
Never fabricate per-key versions or change OCC conflicts
Collision positive means possibly changed and takes ordinary full validation
Capacity clear moves coverage floor forward; missing keys alone do not prove unchanged
Poison, allocation failure, sequence gaps and unknown publication cause fallback
Record only successful known mutations; partial publication must not leave eligible proof
Tie reconstructible journal memory to existing launch budget and preserve total bound
Validate every prospective positive against the existing live Head/Snapshot version comparison before enabling skips
limitations: The model does not execute Rust, WAL, real locks, I/O faults or published query replicas.
No CPU savings or original1s gate improvement measured.
Forced fingerprint collisions and random invalidations make model positive rates unsuitable as workload hit-rate estimates.
An initial capacity0 row may later use nonzero capacity because resize actions are included; proofs are always disabled while the current capacity is0.
next: Build a private native observer with all legacy version reads still executed; measure certified unchanged keys and compare every positive against the legacy oracle before implementing the shortcut.
